Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement is finishing our onboarding checklist and we need a complete list of subprocessors Redwood uses for the hosted inference offering (names, country of processing, purpose, and whether they receive persistent logs). Our security team also wants an indication of which subprocessors have onshore fallbacks for EU-data.

We have a tight window to close this week to meet our go-live on Aug 1. Can you send an inventory or point me to the canonical CSV? Also flag any temporary partners or telemetry vendors that might be covered by a temporary bridge.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — liam

Liam —

Thanks for the note and congrats on the fast timeline. I'm attaching our current canonical roster (redwood_subprocessors_v1.3.csv) — it includes vendor name, role, processing country, and whether persistent logs are retained. Quick callouts:

- Most telemetry and observability partners are EU-onshore capable; the CSV marks the onshore fallback column.
- There is one temporary telemetry bridge (EdgeSight Labs) that is currently in a limited-test mode and may have cross-border exports for short retention windows.
- I've also attached a filled DDQ that answers several of your security team's detailed questions (harborline_ddq_filled.xlsx).

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben (cc) and I will confirm the onshore fallback evidence for EdgeSight by EOD tomorrow.
2) Marissa, can you prepare the DPA addendum draft for Harborline (minor clauses for transit/processor list)? I've started a draft and attached DPA_addendum_draft.docx for legal to iterate on.

If that works, we can route the addendum for signature via DocuSign and share the final evidence bundle.

Best,
Hannah

Liam / Hannah —

Following up on Hannah's note. Quick technical clarification on EdgeSight Labs (temporary telemetry bridge):
- Purpose: lightweight telemetry + request tracing for hosted customers in early 2026 pilot.
- Data types: anonymized metrics + short-lived debug traces. No persistent raw customer inputs are stored by default; we retain traces for up to 48 hours for debugging.
- Processing country: Ireland (primary) with occasional export to US for failover analytics; failover path is controlled and limited to aggregated telemetry.

I'm attaching the relevant vendor statement in the CSV and the compliance excerpt. We'll push the onshore fallback attestation (signed vendor statement + routing diagram) to the Drive folder by EOD tomorrow.

If Harborline requires no temporary bridges, we can gate EdgeSight for your tenant (disable for production) until the DPA addendum is in place. Hannah — should I add that to the rollout gating checklist?

cheers,
Ben

Kimberly is looped to confirm KMS/HSM boundary language for any key transfers.

- I will create a short DocuSign envelope with the DPA addendum (minor changes only) by Friday morning. Expect the link in this thread.
- If Harborline wants the temporary bridge disabled pre-production, we can toggle that as part of tenant cutover.

Kimberly — can you confirm KMS/HSM is not exported to the temporary vendor and that keys remain within EU HSMs for Harborline's tenant? If so, I'll mark the control "in place" in the attestation packet.

Marissa
